What every prophet taught

One religion, many laws

Every prophet carried one religion and one message. Law and way differ from nation to nation.

How many religions did the prophets bring? The Quran names Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus and Muhammad, and gives them one charge: keep the religion and do not split over it. It says Muhammad was told what earlier messengers were told. Each nation received its own law, way and rites. Our languages and colours differ too, and the Quran calls that a sign of God. The laws differ, and the root is one.

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13

﴿لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.

Quran · Al-Hajj 22:67

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:22

You might ask

QuestionIf the laws differ, is it the same religion?
AnswerYes. The Quran says each nation was given a law and a way, to test them in what they received, and then says: race one another in good.Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:48
QuestionMust I choose between the prophets?
AnswerNo. The Quran teaches its reader to believe in what came to all of them, and to make no distinction among them.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:136
QuestionWhy do languages and colours differ?
AnswerThe Quran lists them among God's signs, beside the heavens and the earth. A different voice or face is something to wonder at.Quran · Ar-Rum 30:22

The laws of nations differ, and the religion with God is one.
